what: Amgen is a biotechnology company that makes medicines for bone disease, inflammation, cancer, heart disease and rare diseases, and is developing an obesity drug.
customers: Patients through hospitals, clinics, pharmacies and insurers.
money: Blincyto, Xgeva and the Horizon drugs
moat: Biologic-manufacturing expertise, patents and a broad portfolio that produces a lot of cash.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 10% last year and about 12% a year over three years
Gross margin of 67% with a dividend yield above 2%
Its obesity medicine in late-stage trials would open a far larger market than its current portfolio
watch: Obesity programme trial results and the pace of debt reduction.
